## Table one - stratified by response (met pts)

```{r}
#delete row with missing response data

response_data <- nondup[-38, ]


pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
  x <- x[-length(x)]  # Remove "overall" group
  # Construct vectors of data y, and groups (strata) g
  y <- unlist(x)
  g <- factor(rep(1:length(x), times=sapply(x, length)))
  if (is.numeric(y)) {
    # For numeric variables, perform an ANOVA
    p <- summary(aov(y ~ g))[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
  } else {
    # For categorical variables, perform a chi-squared test of independence
    p <- chisq.test(table(y, g))$p.value
  }
  # Format the p-value, using an HTML entity for the less-than sign.
  # The initial empty string places the output on the line below the variable 
  #label.
  c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits=3, eps=0.001)))
}

 
 table1(~ Age + Sex + Race + Treatment + irAE | Response,
       data=response_data, overall="Total", extra.col=list(`P-value`=pvalue), 
       render.missing=NULL, render.continuous=c(.="Mean (SD)"))
```


#table two- stratified by irae (met pts)
```{r}
pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
  x <- x[-length(x)]  # Remove "overall" group
  # Construct vectors of data y, and groups (strata) g
  y <- unlist(x)
  g <- factor(rep(1:length(x), times=sapply(x, length)))
  if (is.numeric(y)) {
    # For numeric variables, perform an ANOVA
    p <- summary(aov(y ~ g))[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
  } else {
    # For categorical variables, perform a chi-squared test of independence
    p <- chisq.test(table(y, g))$p.value
  }
  # Format the p-value, using an HTML entity for the less-than sign.
  # The initial empty string places the output on the line below the variable 
  #label.
  c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits=3, eps=0.001)))
}

 
 table1(~ Age + Sex + Race + Treatment + Response | irAE,
       data=nondup, overall="Total", extra.col=list(`P-value`=pvalue), 
       render.missing=NULL, render.continuous=c(.="Mean (SD)"))
```

#categorize iraes for all pts
```{r}
irae_labels <- yesirae %>% 
  mutate(iraecat = case_when(yesirae$Symptoms == 
                               "Hyperthyroidism"| yesirae$Symptoms ==
                               "Hypothyroidism"| yesirae$Symptoms ==
                               "Adrenal insufficiency" | yesirae$Symptoms ==
                               "Thyroiditis" | yesirae$Symptoms == 
                               "Hypothyroid" ~ "Endocrine disorders", 
                             yesirae$Symptoms == "Rash" | yesirae$Symptoms == 
                               "Psoriasis flare" | yesirae$Symptoms == 
                               "Skin itching" | yesirae$Symptoms == 
                               "Maculo-paular rash" | yesirae$Symptoms == 
                               "Skin itching" ~ "Skin disorders", 
                             yesirae$Symptoms == 
                               "Diarrhea"| yesirae$Symptoms ==
                               "Autoimmune colitis (diarrhea)" 
                             ~ "Gastrointestinal disorders", yesirae$Symptoms == 
                               "Delirium" ~ "Psychiatric disorders", 
                             yesirae$Symptoms == "Arthralgias" 
                             ~ "Rheumatologic disorders", yesirae$Symptoms == 
                               "Nephritis"  ~ "Renal disorders",
                             TRUE ~ "Liver disorders" ))

```
